name: starter-hud
description: Measures real token, cache and tool-call usage per task and shows it in one row above the prompt, with an AI Dash button, an Update available button and, when the project has docs/pending-decisions.md, the Pending decisions band and pane. Hands the numbers to ai-project-starter's execution log instead of leaving them at zero.

file.title: Decisions file
file.description: Markdown file that lists the pending decisions, relative to the working directory. The band shows only where it exists.

pollMs.title: Watch interval (ms)
pollMs.description: How often the decisions file is checked for changes.

showWhenMissing.title: Show when the file is missing
showWhenMissing.description: Keep the Pending decisions band visible, marked as not found, when the file does not exist.
